glyph_origin: Likely a pictogram (象形) – the handle (⿻⿺㇂丶丿) found on the right hand side of weapons such as 戊 or 戈 or 戉 written stand-alone. Two decorative strokes were then added to the sides. Jiajie (假借 phonetic loan) - The character was subsequently borrowed for a near-homophone meaning "must", and the original meaning came to be represented by 柲 Unrelated to 心, as bronze script makes clear, but in current form very similar.
